questions.standard_level: Algebra I. Common Core groups high-school standards by category, not by course; this bank places this one in Algebra I, following the Common Core traditional pathway (Appendix A) except where engine/hs_courses.py says otherwise.
questions.prompt: A farmer has 100 m of fence for three sides of a rectangular pen; a barn wall forms the fourth side. Each side perpendicular to the wall is x m long. Write the area A(x) of the pen.
questions.prompt_markup:
A farmer has 100 m of fence for three sides of a rectangular pen; a barn wall forms the fourth side. Each side perpendicular to the wall is x m long.
Write the area A(x) of the pen.
questions.grading_note: Any equivalent form, such as 100x - 2x². The side parallel to the wall uses the remaining 100 - 2x meters.

questions.prompt: A theater sells 300 tickets at $20 each. For each $1 increase in price, it sells 10 fewer tickets. Write the revenue R(n) after n price increases of $1.
questions.prompt_markup:
A theater sells 300 tickets at $20 each. For each $1 increase in price, it sells 10 fewer tickets.

questions.grading_note: Any equivalent form, such as -10n² + 100n + 6,000. Revenue = price × tickets sold.

questions.prompt: Ticket demand is q(p) = 500 - 10p tickets at a price of p dollars, and the price after n increases is p(n) = 20 + n. Write q(p(n)) and say what it gives.
questions.prompt_markup:

questions.correct_answer: q(p(n)) = 300 - 10n: the number of tickets sold after n price increases.
questions.grading_note: Form required: the simplified composite and its meaning. 500 - 10(20 + n).
